design: reuse exactly model_trial1 state, candidate display order, enum order, permutations, model and runtime settings; add per-candidate computed evidence and its explanatory instruction only
fairness: Agent and calculator B+ receive identical unsorted evidence; no winner, rank or shortlist is supplied; calculator B+ must equal frozen B+ for every scheduled call
no_edges: compute evidence from supplied no-edge graph only; full reference graph is evaluation-only
metrics_before_run: student-level choice variability across three display permutations
first display position among valid calls
enum position counts among valid calls
soft remediation against common reference graph
diagnostic_success_before_run: all calls valid, agreement >= 0.95 and choice variability <= 0.10 separately in each cohort/variant; diagnostic thresholds only, never automatically authorize Lock C
claims: exploratory calculator-assisted execution of an explicitly supplied deterministic rule, not independent pedagogical reasoning, learning gain or a clean held-out confirmation
limit: one calculator intervention on the previously inspected development subset, no automatic prompt/model sweep or TEST access
